question: Which of the following civilian awards was conferred upon Mulayam Singh Yadav (Posthumous) for the year 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Vibhushan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mulayam Singh Yadav was posthumously awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2023, which is India's second-highest civilian award.
 
• This prestigious award recognizes his exceptional and distinguished service to the nation in public affairs.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is one of the three Padma awards announced annually on the eve of Republic Day.
 
• The award is a testament to Mulayam Singh Yadav's significant contributions to Indian politics and society.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Padma Shri
 The fourth highest civilian award in India, recognizing distinguished contribution in various spheres of activity.
 
 

 Padma Bhushan
 The third highest civilian award, acknowledging distinguished service of a high order to the nation, in any field.
 
 

 Bharat Ratna
 India's highest civilian award, conferred for exceptional service towards advancement of Art, Literature and Science, and in recognition of public service of the highest order.
